messages:
Elena (CEO): Thanks everyone for coming today. Dropping a quick follow-up thread for items we promised to clarify + owners. Recording & slides in the doc: https://drive.google.com/redwood-allhands-03-26
Devon (VP Product): Quick clarifications from roadmap Qs we ran out of time on: 1) Dedicated GA will include autoscaling (single-region) and rollout controls; 2) Private onboarding will include an automated checklist + sample terraform; 3) Eval alerts will be opt-in and delivered via webhook.
Hana (Customer Success): I'll coordinate the private onboarding pilot with two customers. Owner: @Hana. Target: draft checklist by 04/05.
Marcus (Eng Manager): Perf follow-up: we're measuring P95 for common gen shapes; goal is <70ms for small-gen on Dedicated. I’ll post the benchmark artifact next week.
Priya (SRE): Ops note: adding a Dedicated failover drill on 04/12. Please tag critical routes or customers to include them in the runbook.
Leo (Sales): Sales ask: can we get a short one-pager on Dedicated committed pricing and expected throughput? @Tao finance will ship samples; ping me if you need a specific scenario.
infra-bot: "deploy" posted: console v0.9 canary started; smoke tests queued.
Marcus (Eng Manager): Quick: canary shows a small uptick in route_init_time. Investigating root cause now.
Devon (VP Product): Action items I captured (please ack with :white_check_mark: when you own it):
```
- @Hana -> draft private onboarding checklist & pilot (04/05)
- @Marcus -> publish perf benchmark artifact (04/02)
- @Priya -> run Dedicated failover drill (04/12)
- @Leo -> collect sales sample scenarios for finance (03/31)
- @Devon -> update public roadmap doc with timelines (03/30)
```
If you raised a question during the all-hands and didn't get a follow-up, drop it here and we'll assign an owner.
Elena (CEO): We'll do a 30-min leadership AMA next Wed at 11am PT. Put leftover questions in this thread or the shared doc: https://docs.google.com/redwood-allhands-ama.
Marcus (Eng Manager): I'll link the perf PR and dashboard when available.
Priya (SRE): FYI: if the canary smoke fails, I'll post incident notes in #incidents and tag owners.
Devon (VP Product): Thanks all. Small ask: react with :eyes: once you've read this thread so we can track ack rate.
